name: Hamza Raza
text: The birria tacos are unreal — consommé on the side, proper crunch. Delivery arrived hot and 8 minutes early.

name: Sana Iqbal
text: Finally a place that does both Mexican and Thai properly. Pad thai and al pastor tacos in one order is dangerous.

name: Bilal Ahmed
text: The Big Amigo is a two-hands job. Great crust on the smash patties and the tracking page was spot on.

name: Ayesha Khan
text: Loaded fries and churros. That is it. That is the review. Packaging was clean and sauces were labelled.

name: Usman Tariq
text: Ordered the family feast for the team — arrived on time, still crispy. The admin deals actually make it affordable.

name: Mahnoor Ali
text: Paneer fiesta burger and mint margarita is my go-to. Wish the desserts had more eggless options.
